changes.before: Pending as of 2026-09-23. The City Plan Commission is scheduled to hold its hearing and make a recommendation on September 28, 2026; the proposal still requires Common Council approval before taking effect. If adopted, the moratorium would bar city departments/boards/commissions from accepting or processing most new data center applications for one year after passage or until the zoning code is amended to specifically regulate data centers, whichever is first, with an exception for planned-development-district properties and a proposed (contested) tribal-land exemption for the Forest County Potawatomi Community.
changes.after: Official File 251924 Substitute 2 records October 13 passage 13-0, October 14 mayor signature, October 16 publication and October 17 effectiveness. Final text prohibits new data centers/enlargement, exempts planned development districts, excludes accessory server facilities from its definition, and lasts the lesser of one year after passage or effective zoning-code regulation. The retained File 260142 record shows no passage, but complete later-action/current-force and project-applicability review remains unresolved.
